Importing data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(ausflora)
library(performance)
library(austraits)
library(patchwork)

resources <- load_taxonomic_resources()

xylem_areas <- list.files("area_data/", full.names = T) |> 
  map_df(read.csv, header = T) |> 
  separate(Image, c("family_original", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species_name", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |>
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000,
         radius = sqrt(Area.µm.2/pi))

apc_names <- update_taxonomy(xylem_areas$species_name, resources = resources) |>
  filter(grepl("accepted|synonym|variant", taxonomicStatusClean))

# write.csv(apc_names["canonicalName"], "data/apc_names.csv", row.names = F)

gbif_names <- read.csv("data/gbif_namematched.csv", header = T) |> filter(grepl("SPECIES|VARIETY", rank)) 

namematched <- gbif_names |> select(verbatimScientificName, species, genus) |> 
  left_join(apc_names[c("aligned_name", "canonicalName", "family")], by = c("verbatimScientificName" = "canonicalName")) |> 
  rename(species_name = aligned_name, gbif_name = species, apc_name = verbatimScientificName)

xylem_areas <- xylem_areas |> left_join(namematched, by = "species_name")

# xylem_areas <- xylem_areas |> unite(family_original, species_name, state, sep = "/")
# xylem_areas <- xylem_areas |> drop_na(apc_name)
# 
# n_distinct(xylem_areas$family_original)
```


Zanne et al. (2010) comparison
```{r}
zanne_data <- read.csv("data/zanne_data.csv", header = T)
zanne_native <- native_anywhere_in_australia(zanne_data$Binomial, 
                                             resources = resources) |> 
  right_join(zanne_data, by = c("species" = "Binomial")) |> 
  filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "TRUE" )

jugo_data <- xylem_areas |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000, 
         total_area = max(area_mm)) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  summarise(n=n(),
         mean_area = mean(area_mm, na.rm=T),
         n_per_area = n/total_area,
         area_n_ratio = mean_area/n_per_area) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(N = mean(n_per_area, na.rm = T),
            A = mean(mean_area, na.rm = T),
            S = mean(area_n_ratio, na.rm = T)) |>
  drop_na() |> 
  left_join(namematched[c("apc_name", "family")], by = "apc_name") |>
  distinct()


ggplot() +
  # geom_point(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), col = "light grey") +
  geom_hex(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), bins = 15) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "light grey", high = "dark green") +
  # geom_point(data = zanne_native, aes(x = N, y = A), col = "black") +
  geom_point(data = jugo_data, aes(x = N, y = A), size = 1) +
  # geom_smooth(data = jugo_data, aes(x = N, y = A, col = family), method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Vessel density"~ (mm^-2)) +
  ylab("Mean vessel area"~ (mm^2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("figures/zanne_plot.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm")

```


Creating climate preference data
```{r}
# gbif_occurrences <- read.delim("occurrences/gbif_raw_occs.csv", header=T, sep="\t")

# gbif_filtered <- gbif_occurrences |> 
#   select(species, scientificName, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude) |> 
#   drop_na()

# write.csv(gbif_filtered, "occurrences/gbif_filtered.csv", row.names = F)

gbif_filtered <- read.csv("occurrences/gbif_filtered.csv", header = T) |> drop_na()

occurrence_data <- gbif_filtered |> filter(species %in% namematched$gbif_name)

occurrence_points <- vect(occurrence_data, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

raster_list <- list.files("rasters_30s/", full.names = T) |> map(rast)

for (raster in raster_list) {
  occurrence_data <- occurrence_data |> 
    mutate(!!sym(names(raster)) := terra::extract(raster, occurrence_points)[[2]])
}


climate_preferences <- occurrence_data |> 
  group_by(species) |>  
  summarise(mean_MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            tenth_MAP=quantile(MAP, c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm=T)[1],
            sd_log_MAP=sd(log(MAP), na.rm=T),
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            wet_quarter=mean(wet_quarter, na.rm=T),
            dry_quarter=mean(dry_quarter, na.rm=T),
            AI=mean(awi_pm_sr_yr/10000, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            n_obs=n()) |> 
  mutate(climate=cut(AI, breaks=c(-Inf, 0.03, 0.2, 0.5, 0.65, Inf), 
                     labels=c("Hyper Arid", "Arid", "Semi-Arid", "Dry sub-humid", "Humid"))) |> 
  # filter(n > 5) |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas[c(1, 18, 19, 20, 21)], by = c("species" = "gbif_name")) |>
  distinct()
  

write.csv(climate_preferences, "data/climate_preferences.csv", row.names = F)
```


```{r}
occurrence_points <- vect(gbif_filtered, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

rast_list <- list.files("aus_rasters/", full.names = T) |> map(rast) 

for (raster in rast_list) {
  gbif_filtered <- gbif_filtered |> 
    mutate(!!sym(names(raster)) := terra::extract(raster, occurrence_points)[[2]])
}

gbif_filtered <- gbif_filtered |> drop_na()

gbif_filtered_summary <- gbif_filtered |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarise(MAP = mean(Australia_MAP),
            MAT = mean(Australia_MAT), 
            n = n()) |> 
  filter(n > 5)
```


Creating whittaker plot
```{r}
aus_MAP <- rast("rasters/Australia_MAP.tif")
aus_MAT <- rast("rasters/Australia_MAT.tif")

aus_MAP_values <- values(aus_MAP, dataframe = T) |> drop_na() 
aus_MAT_values <- values(aus_MAT, dataframe = T) |> drop_na() 

aus_values <- cbind(aus_MAP_values, aus_MAT_values)

hist(aus_MAP_values$Australia_MAP) 
hist(climate_preferences$mean_MAP)

hist(aus_MAT_values$Australia_MAT)
hist(climate_preferences$MAT)

ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = gbif_filtered_summary, aes(MAP)) +
  geom_density(data = climate_preferences, aes(mean_MAP), col = "red") +
  theme_classic()

ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = gbif_filtered_summary, aes(MAT)) +
  geom_density(data = climate_preferences, aes(MAT), col = "red") +
  theme_classic()


ggplot() +
  geom_hex(data = gbif_filtered_summary, aes(x = MAT, y = MAP)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "light grey", high = "dark green", trans = "log") +
  # geom_density_2d(data = climate_preferences, aes(x = MAT, y =  mean_MAP), bins = 5, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = climate_preferences, aes(x = MAT, y =  mean_MAP), size = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlim(5, 30) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Mean annual temperature (ºC)") +
  ylab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)")

ggsave("figures/climate_range.png", scale = 1.5, width = 7.34, height = 7.34, units = "cm")

```


Vessel area
```{r}
climate_preferences <- read.csv("data/climate_preferences.csv", header = T)

spp_areas <- xylem_areas |> 
  filter(Class == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_area = mean(Area.µm.2, na.rm = T),
            n_vessels = n()) |> 
  drop_na()

species_summary <- spp_areas |> left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name")

ggplot(data = species_summary, aes(x = MAT, y = mean_area)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  # scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "dark grey", high = "red", midpoint = mean(species_summary$seasonality)) +
  # facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") + 
  ylab(bquote("Mean vessel area " (mm^2)))

area_MAP_lm <- lm(log(mean_area)~log(mean_MAP), data = species_summary)
summary(area_MAP_lm)
```

```{r}
species_summary_long <- species_summary |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = mean_MAP:seasonality, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = species_summary_long, aes(value, mean_area)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(family~variable, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() 
```


Hydraulically weighted diameter (Dh)
```{r}
xylem_Dh <- xylem_areas |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |>
  group_by(apc_name, genus, other) |> 
  summarise(sample_Dh = sum(radius^5)/ sum(radius^4)) |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(sample_Dh, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name") |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas["apc_name"], by = "apc_name") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(n_samples = n()) |> 
  drop_na() 

# write.csv(xylem_Dh, "data/xylem_Dh.csv", row.names = F)

Dh_MAP_plot <- ggplot(data = xylem_Dh, aes(x = mean_MAP, y = mean_Dh)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)")

ggsave("figures/Dh_MAP.png", scale = 1.5, width = 7.34, height = 7.34, units = "cm")
  

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae", n_samples > 5), 
       aes(x = mean_MAP, y = mean_Dh)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~genus)+
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)")+
  labs(colour = "Genus")

ggsave("figures/Dh_MAP_genus.png", scale = 1, width = 11, height = 7.34, units = "cm")

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh, 
       aes(x = mean_MAP, y = mean_Dh)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(data = xylem_Dh |> filter(family %in% c("Apocynaceae", "Fabaceae", "Myrtaceae", "Proteaceae", "Rutaceae")),
              method = "lm", se = F) +
  # geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~family)+
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)")

ggsave("figures/Dh_MAP_family.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm")

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh, 
       aes(x = seasonality, y = MAT)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10()

```


```{r}
Dh_family_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP), data = xylem_Dh
            # |> filter(family != "CASUARINACEAE")
            )
summary(Dh_family_lm)

Dh_family_MAP_plus_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP)+family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_family_MAP_plus_lm)

Dh_family_MAP_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP)*family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_family_MAP_lm)

library(emmeans)

interaction_posthoc <- emtrends(Dh_family_MAP_lm, pairwise ~ family, var = "mean_MAP")
interaction_df <- interaction_posthoc$contrasts |> data.frame()
write.csv(interaction_df, "data/interaction_comparison.csv", row.names = F)

multcomp::cld(interaction_posthoc)
contrast(interaction_posthoc, method = "pairwise") |> data.frame()
plot(interaction_posthoc, comparisons = T)

emmip(Dh_family_MAP_lm, family ~ mean_MAP, cov.reduce = range)

pwpp(interaction_posthoc, add.space = 10) +
  theme_bw() +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  ylab("Family")


ggsave("figures/pairwise_interaction.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 7.34, units = "cm")



interaction.plot(xylem_Dh$mean_MAP, 
                 xylem_Dh$family,
                 xylem_Dh$mean_Dh)

anova(Dh_family_lm, Dh_family_MAP_lm)
AIC(Dh_family_lm, Dh_family_MAP_plus_lm, Dh_family_MAP_lm)

Dh_aov <- aov(log(mean_Dh)~family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_aov)
Dh_Tukey <- TukeyHSD(Dh_aov)
Dh_Tukey

# check_model(Dh_aov)
# check_model(Dh_aov)
# r2(Dh_aov)
 
cor(xylem_Dh[, 4:11])
pairs(xylem_Dh[, 4:11])
```

```{r}
library(multcompView)

generate_label_df <- function(TUKEY, variable){

     Tukey.levels <- TUKEY[[variable]][,4]
     Tukey.labels <- data.frame(multcompLetters(Tukey.levels)['Letters'])

     Tukey.labels$treatment=rownames(Tukey.labels)
     Tukey.labels=Tukey.labels[order(Tukey.labels$treatment) , ]
     return(Tukey.labels)
     }
 
LABELS <- generate_label_df(Dh_Tukey , "family")

xylem_Dh <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(LABELS, by = c("family" = "treatment"))

ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = xylem_Dh, aes(family, mean_Dh)) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_text(data = xylem_Dh |> group_by(family, Letters) |> summarise(max_Dh = max(mean_Dh)), 
            aes(family, y = max_Dh + 20, label = Letters)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  xlab("Family") +
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  coord_flip()

ggsave("figures/Dh_family.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 7.34, units = "cm")
```

Creating multivariate faceted graph
```{r}
xylem_Dh_long <- xylem_Dh |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = mean_MAP:AI, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

climate_labs <- c("AI", "Dry quarter", "MAT", "MAP", "MAP range", "Tenth pct MAP","Seasonality", "Wet quarter")
names(climate_labs) <- c("AI", "dry_quarter", "MAT", "mean_MAP", "sd_log_MAP", "seasonality", "tenth_MAP", "wet_quarter")

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_long, aes(value, mean_Dh)) +
  geom_hex(data = xylem_Dh_long[,c(2, 10, 11)], aes(value, mean_Dh), bins = 10) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "light grey", high = "dark green", trans = "log") +
  # geom_point(data = xylem_Dh_long[,c(2, 10, 11)], aes(value, mean_Dh), col = "light grey") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  # geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_grid(family~variable, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(variable = climate_labs)) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Value") +
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("figures/Dh_variables.png", scale = 1.5, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm")

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_long |> filter(n_samples > 5), aes(value, mean_Dh)) +
  geom_point(data = xylem_Dh_long[,c(2, 10, 11)], aes(value, mean_Dh), col = "light grey") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_grid(genus~variable, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

Dh_long_aov <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(value)+variable+genus, data = xylem_Dh_long |> filter(n_samples > 5))
summary(Dh_long_aov)
```

Lumen fraction
```{r}
xylem_lumen_frac <- xylem_areas |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  mutate(sample_lumen_area = max(Area.µm.2)) |> 
  filter(Name %in% c("vessel", "part")) |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  summarise(vessel_area = sum(Area.µm.2),
            sample_lumen_frac = vessel_area/sample_lumen_area) |> 
  distinct() |>
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_lumen_frac = mean(sample_lumen_frac, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name") |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas["apc_name"], by = "apc_name") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(n_samples = n()) |> 
  drop_na() 

ggplot(data = xylem_lumen_frac, aes(x = mean_MAP, y = mean_lumen_frac)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~family)

ggplot(data = xylem_lumen_frac |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae", n_samples > 3), aes(x = mean_MAP, y = mean_lumen_frac, col = genus)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~genus)
```

adding height data
```{r}
library(austraits)

austraits <- readRDS("data/austraits.rds")

height_data <- extract_trait(austraits, "plant_height")

euc_heights <- height_data$traits |> 
  filter(taxon_name %in% xylem_Dh$apc_name) |> 
  filter(value_type == "maximum") |> 
  group_by(taxon_name) |> 
  summarise(max_height = max(value),
            mean_height = mean(value))

xylem_Dh_height <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(euc_heights, by = c("apc_name"= "taxon_name"))

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(mean_height, mean_Dh)) +
  # ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(AI, max_height)) +
# ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(max_height, mean_Dh)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = mean_MAP), size = 1) +
  # scale_x_log10() +
  # scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "grey", high = "#0000FF", midpoint = median(log(xylem_Dh_height$mean_MAP)), trans = "log") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Maximum plant height (m)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  labs(colour = "MAP (mm)")
  

ggsave("figures/Dh_height_MAP.png", scale = 1, width = 11, height = 7.34, units = "cm")

Dh_height_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_height), data = xylem_Dh_height)
summary(Dh_height_lm)

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(family, max_height)) +
  geom_boxplot()

```


Adding TRY vessel trait data
```{r}
TRY_vessel_data <- read.csv("data/TRY_vessel_data.csv", header = T)

TRY_vessel_diameter <- TRY_vessel_data |> filter(TraitName == "Wood vessel diameter")
TRY_natives <- TRY_vessel_diameter$SpeciesName |> 
  native_anywhere_in_australia(resources = resources) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == TRUE)

vessel_grouping <- TRY_vessel_diam |> filter(TraitName == "Wood vessel grouping")
clustered <- vessel_grouping |> filter(OrigValueStr == "clusters")

species_grouping <- read.csv("data/matched_names.csv", header = T)
xylem_Dh_grouping <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(species_grouping, by = "species")

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_grouping, aes(x = mean_MAP, y = mean_Dh, col = grouping)) +
```

```{r}
# Library
library(networkD3)
library(dplyr)
 
links <- read.csv("data/sankey_links.csv", header = T)
nodes <- read.csv("data/sankey_nodes.csv", header = T)

# A connection data frame is a list of flows with intensity for each flow
links <- data.frame(
  source=c("group_A","group_A", "group_B", "group_C", "group_C", "group_E"), 
  target=c("group_C","group_D", "group_E", "group_F", "group_G", "group_H"), 
  value=c(2,3, 2, 3, 1, 3)
  )
 
# From these flows we need to create a node data frame: it lists every entities involved in the flow
nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique()
)
 
# With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
# Make the Network
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
              sinksRight=FALSE, width = 1000, height = 500, fontSize = 20, fontFamily = "Arial")
p
```
